project_direction: Continue independent custom firmware; no dependency on an official NUX NAM release.
requirements: Owned executable code and 8-byte aligned stack; no initialized C data required for watchdog routine
Privileged Thread mode, CONTROL=0, PRIMASK=1, FAULTMASK=0
Exclusive processor/peripheral ownership including M4 watchdog; physical ownership still unverified
Legacy watchdog WDE already clear; enabled legacy watchdog requires a future service policy
RTWDOG state settled with RCS=1 and ULK=0; enabled RTWDOG must allow UPDATE
actions: Stackless enabled/size checks for ITCM and DTCM before MSP or any RAM/MMIO write; reject insufficient declared capacity
Check every watchdog before peripheral writes
Disable and read back separate WMCR power-down counters
Use packed or adjacent split unlock commands, wait for ULK with finite polling, clear EN without clearing W1C flags
Wait for RCS and lock closure; verify configuration; stop before C runtime on any failure
Inspect M7 root/PLL twice after C initialization and reject unsupported/changing configurations
clock_scope: Only stable software-controlled ARM PLL on M7 mux 4 with caller-established 24MHz reference. Derives rate but does not measure frequency, choose a safe voltage/speed grade, or program clocks. Image passes reference=0, so it never assumes the board reference.
physical_limits: Polling bounds are operation counts, not measured bus/watchdog time
31/255 bus-clock windows and minimum 2.5 watchdog clocks since loader reconfiguration remain unmeasured
Initial reset-only configuration window is deliberately unsupported without reset provenance
NMI/fault behavior and remaining timeout before entry are not established
On partial failure no rollback is attempted; remaining live watchdogs may reset physical hardware
Cache/MPU-enabled entry still rejected; RAM mapping, quiescence, electrical mute and USB recovery unproved

tcm_guard.fixture_correction: Prior DTCM fixture 0x39 declared only 64KiB despite a 216KiB stack-top offset. Updated accepted fixture is 0x49 (256KiB); old value is explicitly rejected.
